start: Admin app sign-in page; the owner has a PIN already

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the 6-digit PIN, tap 'Sign in'
user_sees: The gym opens on Today
must_not: Another gym of the same mobile opened when its PIN differs
The PIN shown back in any box or message

steps.action: Open Settings, 'Change my PIN', type the current PIN and a new one twice, tap 'Save new PIN'
user_sees: Line '· PIN set'
must_not: The old PIN still signs in afterwards
The new PIN set in one branch only when the owner has branches

start: Sign-in page; owner has forgotten the PIN and has a one-time code (from WhatsApp or another signed-in device)

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the one-time code in the PIN box, tap 'Sign in'
user_sees: The gym opens
Offer 'Choose a new PIN?'
must_not: The code accepted a second time
The code refused because a PIN exists

steps.action: Within 15 minutes choose a new 6-digit PIN, tap 'Save my PIN'
user_sees: '· PIN set'
No box asking for the old PIN
must_not: The old PIN asked for within 15 minutes of a code sign-in

start: Sign-in page; someone types wrong PINs for the owner's mobile

steps.action: Type a wrong PIN 4 times
user_sees: A wrong-PIN line with the tries left
must_not: The tries-left number going up

steps.action: Type a wrong PIN a 5th time
user_sees: 'Too many tries right now. Wait a little, then try again.'
must_not: A 6th try checked
The right PIN signing in while locked

steps.action: Later the same day get locked a 3rd time
user_sees: The lock lasts 1 hour, not 15 minutes
must_not: The lock never growing

steps.action: In Settings try the weak PIN 123456 as a new PIN
user_sees: The PIN refused as easy to guess
must_not: 123456 or the last 6 digits of the mobile saved

start: Owner with two branches and no PIN yet ('· No PIN yet')

steps.action: Set a PIN in branch A ('Choose a 6-digit PIN', 'Save my PIN')
user_sees: '· PIN set'
must_not: Branch B still shows '· No PIN yet'

steps.action: Sign out and sign in with the same PIN; open branch B
user_sees: Branch B opens with the same PIN
must_not: A second PIN needed for branch B

steps.action: Change the PIN, then try the old one
user_sees: The old PIN refused as wrong
must_not: Both PINs working

start: Owner opens Staff & sign-in to see who has a PIN

steps.action: Look at each person's row
user_sees: '· PIN set' or '· No PIN yet'
A lock time when a PIN is locked
must_not: Any PIN or part of a PIN shown
Another gym's people listed

steps.action: Ask the server for this device's PIN status
user_sees: Only: has a PIN, when set, whether the current one is needed, lock time
must_not: The PIN or its coded form sent to the device

start: A new front-desk person got a one-time code from the owner

steps.action: Type the mobile number and the code, tap 'Sign in'
user_sees: The gym opens
'Choose a 6-digit PIN'
must_not: The owner's own screens shown to the desk

steps.action: Choose a PIN, tap 'Save my PIN'
user_sees: '· PIN set'
must_not: The PIN set for the owner instead

steps.action: Next day sign in with mobile and PIN
user_sees: The gym opens
must_not: A new code needed every day

start: Desk person reopens the admin app on a device already signed in

steps.action: Open the admin app
user_sees: The gym opens without asking for the PIN
The demo-gym flag is false for a real gym
must_not: The sign-in page shown while the session is live
Another gym's name

start: Desk person changes the PIN in Settings

steps.action: Type a new PIN equal to the last 6 digits of the own mobile
user_sees: The PIN refused as easy to guess
must_not: The weak PIN saved

steps.action: Type a wrong current PIN 5 times
user_sees: Wrong-PIN line with tries left, then a lock message
must_not: The PIN changed without the right current PIN

start: Desk person has a PIN; the owner removes them from Staff & sign-in

steps.action: Owner removes the person
user_sees: The person gone from the list
must_not: The person still listed

steps.action: The removed person types mobile and old PIN
user_sees: A wrong-PIN answer
must_not: The old PIN still opening the gym

steps.action: Look at the PIN card
user_sees: Only the own PIN state
must_not: Any other person's PIN state or phone shown to the desk
